meta.title: Spectre tiling strand statistics (circuits & tails) — verified dataset

source_files.note: Byte-identical copies exist at web/src/data/lvl4.csv and web/src/data/lvl6.csv.

provenance.source_of_truth: The two CSVs plus graph_analysis/README.md. The generating code is not in the repository (the notebook Spectre_Patterns.ipynb never writes these CSVs, and its in-repo component classifier differs from whatever produced them — the CSVs contain length-2 circuits the notebook's set-based adjacency could not classify correctly). Semantics were cross-checked against notebook cells 6, 8, 29, 39/40, 44.
provenance.verification: Every number in this file was independently recomputed from the raw CSVs (540 rows, zero consistency violations: tails==sum(tail_lengths), max_tail==max key, max_circuit==max(circuit_lengths) or 0 when empty, circuits==0 iff circuit_lengths empty, circuit_lengths sorted-unique). Two independent verification passes ran 2026-08-03.
provenance.readme_erratum: graph_analysis/README.md calls combo 'a binary string'; that is inaccurate — 96 of 270 combos per level contain digits 2-4 (the Theta digit in the '023678' family ranges 0-4). Digits are option indices, not bits.

units.explanation: circuit_lengths, tail_lengths, max_circuit, max_tail all count strand SEGMENTS: one segment is one strand crossing one tile, between two tile-boundary edge midpoints (graph edges of the notebook's make_edge_graph). Not tiles of the tiling and not vertices — the data contains tails of length 1, which rules out vertex counting (an open component always has >= 2 vertices). For circuits, edge count equals vertex count, so circuit lengths are convention-independent.

edge_selections.app_valid_selections_source: web/src/core/subsets.ts SPECTRE_VALID_SUBSETS — app-level validity, NOT CSV coverage.
edge_selections.note: Only 6 of the 8 app-valid edge selections have rows in the CSVs. Consumers must join against selections_in_data, not app_valid_selections.

data_dictionary.combo: 10-character option-index string aligned with all_tile_names (leftmost digit = Delta). Digit i indexes tile i's non-crossing edge-pairing option (alphabet 0-4 observed; NOT binary). Combos within a selection enumerate the full cartesian product of per-tile non-crossing options.
data_dictionary.edge_selection: Which major edge types (digits of the Spectre edge labels) are active, e.g. '0136'.
data_dictionary.level (lvl4/lvl6): Supertile expansion depth: N iterations of buildSupertiles starting from buildSpectreBase()'s Delta metatile.
data_dictionary.circuits: Total number of closed loops in the configuration's strand graph.
data_dictionary.max_circuit: Length in segments of the longest circuit; 0 means no circuits exist (only open paths) — such configs are space-filling-curve CANDIDATES (finite-depth evidence only, per the README's own hedge 'potentially space filling').
data_dictionary.max_tail: Length in segments of the longest tail.
data_dictionary.circuit_lengths: Sorted list of UNIQUE circuit lengths. Per-length circuit counts are NOT recorded in the source data, so circuit-length distributions cannot be reconstructed — only the set of lengths and the total count.
data_dictionary.tail_lengths: Histogram: tail length (segments, as string key) -> count of tails of that length. Values sum to 'tails'.
data_dictionary.*_stats.sum_across_combos / tail_length_: Pooled across a selection's combos. Combos are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE alternative configurations of the same tiling region, so these are dataset summary statistics, never properties of any single tiling (no tiling has 4085 circuits under selection '15').
data_dictionary.exemplars: Per-selection record configs. Exemplar combo = first among ties in CSV row order; the 'ties' array lists every tied combo.
data_dictionary.records: Global records across both levels with ALL tied holders enumerated.
data_dictionary.lvl4_vs_lvl6.pairs: Per-(selection,combo) growth from depth 4 to depth 6; both CSVs share the identical 270 keys, so pairs are exact.

caveats: circuit_lengths holds unique lengths only — per-length circuit multiplicities are unrecoverable from this data.

The CSV schema records only open paths (tails) and closed loops (circuits). The notebook also produces branching 'other' components; for selection '1278' this cannot matter (no edge 0 is active, every vertex has degree <= 2, so components are exactly paths or cycles — the circuit-free rows are rigorous there), but for selections containing edge 0 it is unverifiable from the repo whether the generator counted branched components under tails or dropped them.
A circuit-length set identical at lvl4 and lvl6 is evidence, not proof, of a finite circuit vocabulary in the infinite tiling; likewise 'space-filling-curve candidate' is a finite-depth observation.
In selection '15' the per-combo circuit-length sets are [3], [3,6], [3,6,9], [3,6,9] — all subsets of {3,6,9}, frozen at both depths; only 2 of the 4 combos individually reach the selection max of 9.
graph_analysis/README.md describes a mega_df.csv that is not in the repo; lvl4/lvl6.csv share its schema and are presumed cuts of it.
